title: Organisation webhook event (v1) — the body of one signed delivery to an organisation's endpoint
description:
The JSON body the platform POSTs to an address an organisation registered for its webhooks (APP-063; FS04-069, FS04-072): one notice of a change to what the organisation holds, fired from the entitlement's own transition (FS05-043). Every delivery of one notice, to every endpoint and at every attempt, carries the same bytes.

SIGNATURE. Each request carries `X-PSN-Signature-256: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<64 lower-case hex>`. `v1` is HMAC-SHA256 keyed with the endpoint's secret exactly as it was shown (its UTF-8 bytes, the `psn_whsec_` prefix included), over the decimal timestamp, a full stop, and the raw body bytes as received. A receiver recomputes it over the bytes it received (never over a re-serialised body), compares in constant time, and refuses a timestamp more than 300 seconds from its own clock, so a captured delivery cannot be replayed later. The `id` inside the signed body is the event id to dedupe on: a retry or a redelivery carries the same `id`. The request also carries `X-PSN-Event-Id` and `X-PSN-Event-Type` with the same values as the body, for routing before the body is read; the body is what is signed.

DELIVERY. A 2xx answer is a delivery; anything else, a timeout or a refused connection is retried with exponential backoff and jitter, at most twelve attempts a round; redirects are not followed. The answer's body is not read beyond 1 KiB and never stored.

PERSONAL DATA: NONE. A notice carries the organisation's own record as its dashboard shows it, and never an account id, a login, a name or an address.

VERSION 1 sends the entitlement lifecycle. APP-063's other notices (a purchase still pending, the T-60/T-30/T-7 reminders, a Schedule-version change, a certificate issued or revoked) come with a later version of this schema, which widens `type` and `data` and never redefines a value already published.

x-psn.phase: P-M3, after launch (after-launch item 3.3): sent by jobs.org-webhooks from its release; never published as a file
x-psn.artifactPath: never published: the body of POST {an endpoint's registered https address}, signed in X-PSN-Signature-256
x-psn.producer: jobs.org-webhooks (the delivery engine; the notice is recorded by jobs.commerce in the transition's own transaction)
consumers: an organisation's own systems (its OSPO, procurement or compliance tooling)

schema.description: This schema's name and version, so a receiver that keeps bodies can tell later which contract one was sent under.

id.description: The event's ULID (FS-00 §6.1, §6.6). The same in every attempt and every redelivery of this notice: dedupe on it.

type.description: What happened (APP-063). `entitlement.activated`: the first term began. `entitlement.renewed`: a further paid term began, from `active` or from `grace`. `entitlement.grace_started`: the term ended with no renewal settled, and the entitlement is in its 30-day grace (COM-042). `entitlement.lapsed`: it ended unrenewed. `entitlement.reinstated`: it is `active` again with no new term (a chargeback reversed). `entitlement.suspended`: a chargeback's first stage. `entitlement.revoked`: a refund or an upheld chargeback. An endpoint registered for `entitlement.*` receives every one of them. Additive: a later version may add a value, and never redefines one.

occurredAt.description: When the transition took effect, as its own event says (FS05-053 orders by it).

recordedAt.description: When the platform recorded the notice. An endpoint receives the notices recorded after it was registered.

coId.description: The organisation the notice is for: the one that registered the endpoint.

instant.description: UTC, to the second, with a `Z`.

day.description: A UTC calendar day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, or null where the entitlement has none yet.

entitlementData.description: The entitlement as the transition left it, as the organisation's own dashboard shows it.

periodStart.description: The first day of its current term.

periodEnd.description: The day its current term ends.

graceEnd.description: The day its grace ends: its term's end plus 30 days (COM-042).
